newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street seen mixed to higher at opening.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street seen mixed to higher at opening.

text.p: Wall Street is expected to open mixed to slightly higher on Thursday, riding a wave of positive momentum after the Dow industrials powered past the 8,000-point mark on Wednesday but subject to mild profit-taking, analysts said.
Stocks could face some profit-taking after the Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up 63 points at 8,039, they said.
But a steady stream of corporate earnings, including results from several Dow components and Microsoft Corp could then provide fresh impetus to move higher.
